Preset.name: Init Vessel
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: The engine's defaults: sub stack, saw-ish table through the ladders, a little drone, dust and tape. Expression lightly routed so every patch starts playable.

Preset.name: Undertow
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A legato sub stack under a warm analog ladder saw that stays closed until you dig in, its cutoff wandering on its own. Velocity opens the ladder and thickens the sub; the wheel leans on the tube; pressure lifts resonance.

Preset.name: Pressure Floor
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A pure, played-pitch sine sub with a 909-style knock on every attack and a long tail. Harder hits add harmonic weight and length; the wheel drives the tube; pressure adds the octave below.

Preset.name: Iron Lung
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A square-leaning sub through a bias-starved tube, an idling V8 growl riding on top and breathing slowly. Velocity bites harder; the wheel drives the tube and sags the supply; pressure tilts it bright.

Preset.name: Black Tar
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A sub and a sub-octave table that churns slowly from sine toward grit under a closed ladder, with a rumble drone ducked by the sub. Velocity opens the envelope; the wheel morphs the table; pressure raises the rumble.

Preset.name: Low Prayer
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: Polyphonic sub pads with a hummed vocal table sung through cello-body formants. Velocity moves the vowel; the wheel brings the voice up; pressure shifts the formants up and sharpens them.

Preset.name: Tremor
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A tempo-locked eighth-note pulse in the sub's saturation and a sputtering growl gated on the same beat, under a pumping dark drone. Velocity deepens the grit; the wheel brings in a saw; pressure drives the tube.

Preset.name: Tape Sub Drop
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: The tape motor spins up on the first note and winds down when you let go, under a sine that shows its saw as it opens. Velocity snaps the start; the wheel drives the tube and adds wow; pressure thickens the sub.

Preset.name: Reese Undercurrent
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A true reese table drifting through parallel ladders, its phase and its frame both sweeping slowly over a sine sub. Velocity opens ladder B; the wheel opens ladder A and widens the drift; pressure squeezes the multiband.

Preset.name: Grinder
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A roaring growl table into a pentode, half-crushed, with a snappy resonant envelope. Velocity widens the envelope and drive; the wheel crushes harder; pressure adds resonance.

Preset.name: Wet Concrete
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: Grit table resonating in a concrete pipe. Velocity opens the ladder; the wheel floods the pipe; pressure pulls the table back toward the vox frame.

Preset.name: Hollow Pulse
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A classic analog pulse with fast PWM and a sixteenth-note filter pulse. Velocity narrows the pulse; the wheel adds resonance; pressure opens the ladder and deepens the PWM.

Preset.name: Vinyl Slab
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: An upright-bass table through 11 kHz crunch, with record noise that breathes with the playing. Velocity opens the ladder; the wheel adds crackle; pressure drops the sample rate.

Preset.name: Gutter Wobble
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: An eighth-note wobble through the ladder, the formant vowel and a monster growl table at once, into a pentode. Velocity drives the ladder; the wheel adds resonance and warps the wobble shape; pressure brings in the voice.

Preset.name: Ghost Reese
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A dual-saw reese with heavy drift and flutter, widened above 350 Hz only. Velocity opens the ladder; the wheel opens both ladders; pressure adds resonance and flutter.

Preset.name: Static Bite
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: Crushed bass that stutters on the sixteenths. Velocity opens the ladder; the wheel drives the tube and drops bits; pressure drops the sample rate.

Preset.name: Velvet Mud
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A warm tube-organ table through an envelope-following wah that opens with your dynamics, into soft tape. Velocity deepens the wah; the wheel lifts the wah and fattens the table; pressure makes the wah resonate.

Preset.name: Concrete Hymn
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A slow sung 'ah' and a drone inside a concrete pipe and a long black hole, cello-bodied. Velocity opens the ladder; the wheel floods the pipe; pressure tilts it bright and stirs the drone.

Preset.name: Liminal Freeze
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A 42-second black hole holding a cloudy, slowly morphing table and a held drone; the tape winds down when you let go. Velocity morphs the table; the wheel brightens and lengthens the hole; pressure pulls it forward.

Preset.name: Broken VHS Choir
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A digital choir on a stretched tape with sagging bias; the vowel drifts on its own. Velocity shifts the formants; the wheel drives the tube and bends the tape; pressure tilts it bright and sharpens the vowels.

Preset.name: Cold Cathedral
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A bright 80s pulse table with slow PWM, open ladders, excited air and a bright, undamped hall with a faint octave-up shimmer of grains. Velocity opens the ladder; the wheel adds air; pressure adds resonance and deepens the PWM.

Preset.name: Ash Garden
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A hazy table slowly drawn from soft to bright under an octave-up grain shimmer. Velocity opens the ladder; the wheel brings up the grains; pressure lifts the shimmer another octave and scatters it.

Preset.name: Sodium Lights
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: Twin detuned saws drifting heavily through a light crush and old tape, under a warm, resonant lowpass that moves slowly. Velocity adds crush; the wheel opens the ladder and drifts further; pressure drives the tube and widens.

Preset.name: Requiem Machine
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A struck-metal table ringing in a water tank, with cello-bodied formants that random-walk. Velocity morphs the table; the wheel floods the tank and brightens the drone; pressure shifts the formants.

Preset.name: Mourning Glass
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: Additive glass partials that slowly re-voice themselves, with excited air and a shimmering phase warp, close-miked. Velocity adds air; the wheel morphs the table; pressure drives the tube and sends it into the hall.

Preset.name: Black Infinity
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: An infinite black hole holding a two-octave-down drone and a slowly turning spectral table. Velocity brightens the drone; the wheel tilts it bright and spreads the drone; pressure drives the tube and stirs the hole.

Preset.name: Transformer Hum
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: 60 Hz transformer buzz, tape hiss and dust over a dark drone on a sagging supply. Velocity raises the hum; the wheel brightens the drone and the hiss; pressure drives the tube and sags harder.

Preset.name: Sunken Bell
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A drowned bell table and water-tank modes ringing over a moving drone, the tank breathing on a drawn curve. Velocity brightens; the wheel floods the tank; pressure moves the vowel.

Preset.name: Pressure Ritual
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A held drone pumped by every note, its tone stepping on the beat, a dark-matter growl underneath. Velocity brightens and deepens the pump; the wheel drives the tube and stirs the drone; pressure tilts it bright and lifts it.

Preset.name: Static Prayer
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A wide drone and a many-vowelled voice table, sung through formants that drift through every vowel over twenty seconds. Velocity shifts the formants; the wheel tilts it bright and sharpens the formants; pressure drives the tube and spreads the drone.

Preset.name: Lake of Dust
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A dense, sprayed grain cloud over hiss, dust and a pale, airy table. Velocity pitches the grains up and thickens the cloud; the wheel drives the tube and lengthens the grains; pressure tilts it bright and raises the hiss.

Preset.name: Witch Static
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A crushed robot-voice lead with dust, an I-vowel and sixteenth stutters; a glitch LFO chews the ladder. Velocity drops bits; the wheel stutters more; pressure moves the vowel.

Preset.name: Sodium Lead
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A legato vintage poly saw with PWM, a gentle vibrato and a little air. Velocity opens the envelope; the wheel drives the tube and adds resonance; pressure tilts it bright and speeds the vibrato.

Preset.name: Choir of Wires
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A talking voice table through formants and an old TV speaker. Velocity moves the vowel; the wheel morphs the voice; pressure shifts the formants up and sharpens them.

Preset.name: Flesh Siren
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A gliding screamer table through a hot pentode and a sagging supply, with a resonant envelope. Velocity drives the tube; the wheel morphs the scream brighter and adds resonance; pressure narrows the pulse.

Preset.name: Tape Ghost
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A soft flute on a warbling, worn tape, set back in the room. Velocity freshens the tape; the wheel warms it with the tube and adds wow; pressure opens the ladder.

Preset.name: Neon Funeral
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A hard-synced table gated by a sixteenth-note square in the ladder. Velocity opens the gate; the wheel drives the tube and skews the gate; pressure adds air.

Preset.name: Rotted Tines
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A classic electric-piano table with a bright, velocity-driven strike on worn tape. Velocity opens the strike and the table; the wheel morphs the tines and adds wow; pressure drives the tube and the tape.

Preset.name: Cassette Organ
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A drawbar organ table through a cassette shell, no attack, no decay. Velocity morphs the stops; the wheel pushes it into the shell and adds flutter; pressure opens the ladder.

Preset.name: Hymn for Static
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: Soft vintage-sampler choir keys with a faint formant body in a medium hall. Velocity brings up the body; the wheel sends to the hall; pressure moves the vowel.

Preset.name: Broken Celeste
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A crushed music-box bell through a tiny TV speaker. Velocity adds sparkle; the wheel drops bits and crushes harder; pressure fills the speaker.

Preset.name: Glass Splinter
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A resonant chime pluck, wide and short. Velocity drives the tube and opens the ladder; the wheel morphs the chime and makes it ring; pressure adds hall.

Preset.name: Dust Pluck
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A palm-muted guitar table through 12 kHz crunch and dust. Velocity opens the ladder; the wheel adds crackle; pressure crushes harder.

Preset.name: Hollow Drip
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: Glass-marimba drops set far back, with a long pre-delay. Velocity morphs the table; the wheel brings it forward; pressure adds resonance and lifts the top.

Preset.name: Stutter Shard
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: Bright digital plucks shattered into 32nd-note stutters, some reversed. Velocity drives the tube and reverses more grains; the wheel stutters more; pressure pitches the grains up.

Preset.name: Rain on Tin
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: Bright crackle and a rippling metal table ringing in a water tank, through a sprayed grain cloud. Velocity adds crackle; the wheel tilts it bright and scatters the grains; pressure fills the tank.

Preset.name: Chapel Radio
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A choir heard through a broken TV: a sung 'ah' table, formants, mains hum, hiss and an 8 kHz crunch. Velocity moves the vowel; the wheel raises the hum; pressure lowers the sample rate.

Preset.name: Breathing Walls
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A breathing drone and a sighing voice table through an envelope-following filter, pumped by your notes, its base cutoff drawn by hand. Velocity deepens the follower; the wheel opens the follower and adds motion; pressure brightens the drone and grows the room.

Preset.name: Shattered Loop
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A transforming digital table cut into triplet-eighth stutters, half reversed and stretched, through a crusher. Velocity stretches; the wheel raises the chance; pressure drops the sample rate and reverses more.

Preset.name: Night Bus
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: Lowpassed, drifting vintage poly saws on a tired tape, heard from the back seat. Velocity opens the ladder; the wheel morphs the table and adds drift; pressure brings it closer.

Preset.name: Ferro Field
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: Ladders on the edge of self-oscillation, pinging off a hollow table. Velocity edges the resonance; the wheel tunes ladder B; pressure drives the tube and the ladders.

Preset.name: Tape Stop Funeral
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A violin section that spins up out of silence and winds down when released. Velocity lengthens the stop; the wheel brightens it and adds wow; pressure sends to the hole.

Preset.name: Black Hole Riser
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A slow swell that rises over four bars as the ladder, the hole and a sweeping table all open. Velocity opens further; the wheel extends the decay; pressure raises the hiss.

Preset.name: Signal Loss
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A noisy FM table on rotting tape with dropouts, a glitch LFO chewing the sample rate, grains breaking up. Velocity drives the tube and drops bits; the wheel drops the sample rate and adds wow; pressure breaks it up more.

Preset.name: Summoning
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: An octave-down grain choir of monks and formants in a 25-second hole. Velocity pitches the grains lower; the wheel moves the vowel; pressure darkens the formants and sends deeper.

Preset.name: Air Raid
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A squealing FM siren through a hot pentode on a slow pitch LFO and stretched tape. Velocity drives the tube; the wheel morphs the table and speeds the siren; pressure tilts it bright and adds resonance.

Preset.name: Collapse
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: An engine-noise table squashed by a deep multiband, crushed, then the tape stops on release. Velocity squashes harder; the wheel crushes and tilts it bright; pressure drops bits and lifts the quiet parts.

Preset.name: Iron Strings
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A steel string plucked by a short saw blip: a Karplus-Strong waveguide with a little stiffness, so the upper partials stretch like piano wire, and a slow wander in its brightness. Velocity brightens the pluck and hits harder; the wheel moves the pluck toward the middle of the string and stretches the partials; pressure drives the tube and lets the string ring on.

Preset.name: Drowned Bell
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A church bell as seven struck modes (hum, prime, tierce, quint, nominal) ringing on after the key under worn tape; a slow wow fades in while you hold. Velocity brightens and hardens the strike; the wheel tilts it bright and floods the hall; pressure drives the tube and bends the partials out of tune.

Preset.name: Hollow Reed
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A closed bore blown by breath: hiss and a soft saw drive the tube's odd harmonics, legato so the bore glides with the voice, and a breath tremolo fades in on long notes. Velocity brightens the reed and blows harder; the wheel drives the tube and adds breath; pressure opens the reed and the hiss.

Preset.name: Bone Marimba
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A free-free bar struck by a tiny click, ringing at the bar's own 1 : 2.76 : 5.40 partials, with the strike point stepping across the bar on a sixteenth-note staircase so no two notes ring alike. Velocity hardens the mallet; the wheel tilts it bright and stretches the bar; pressure drives the tube and lengthens the ring.

Preset.name: Skin Ritual
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A struck drum skin over a clean sine sub: membrane partials with a one-shot pitch drop on every hit, while the sub stays outside the resonator. Velocity brightens the skin and hits harder; the wheel drives the tube and lets the skin ring; pressure tilts it bright and detunes the partials.

Preset.name: Cathedral Wire
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: Sympathetic strings an octave up, never plucked hard, only bowed by the drone and the dust; the bowing point wanders slowly, sweeping the strings' comb like a phaser, and a shimmer fades in. Velocity brightens the strings and bows harder; the wheel tilts it bright and stretches the partials; pressure drives the tube and moves the bow.

Preset.name: Leviathan Braam
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: The trailer braam: a big-brass table with a pentode rasp, brass formants and a ladder that tears open over half a second, into a nine-second hall. Velocity hits brighter and harder; the wheel is the dynamics, opening the filter and pushing the brass; pressure growls.

Preset.name: Titan Horn
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: Low brass for long lines and swells: a French-horn table through an open O vowel and a triode, with a horn vibrato that arrives after a second. Velocity sets how hard the attack speaks; the wheel is the dynamics, from a dark murmur to an open blare; pressure adds rasp and resonance.

Preset.name: Colossus Hit
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A trailer impact: a big-brass blast and a struck drum skin that both fall an octave as they ring, into a concrete-dark hall. Velocity hits the skin harder and brighter; the wheel throws it further into the space and lengthens the boom; pressure drives the ladders.

Preset.name: Iron Siege
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A war machine of a braam: a fuzzed bell-metal table through a starved tube, tape saturation and a touch of bit loss, with a gnashing resonance, ringing inside a steel tank and a dark hall. Velocity opens it and crushes harder; the wheel pushes it into the steel tank and saturates the tape; pressure drops the bits and bites the resonance.

Preset.name: Warship Bloom
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A braam that takes its time: an engine-growl table surfaces over a second and the ladders keep opening for three more, a fleet coming over the horizon in a twelve-second hall. Velocity starts it brighter; the wheel is the dynamics and widens the room; pressure drives the tube and the brass vowel.

Preset.name: Impact Ruin
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: Destruction in one key: a struck steel bar and a crushed bell-metal blast that drop an octave together, into a concrete pipe and a long hall. Velocity hits the bar harder and brighter; the wheel crushes it and stretches the tail; pressure bends the bar's partials and drives the tube.

Preset.name: Buried Giant
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: Something enormous breathing under the sand: an octave-down didgeridoo table, a drum skin rumbling on the input, a drone a fifth wide and grains read backwards, all wandering slowly. Velocity adds weight and opens the ladder; the wheel growls the tube and thickens the grains; pressure rattles the skin harder.

Preset.name: Abyssal Drop
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: The sub drop: a sine-to-triangle tone with triode harmonics falls a full octave over two and a half seconds, darkening as it goes, so it reads on small speakers and shakes big ones. Velocity drives it harder and brighter; the wheel slows the fall and opens the room; pressure saturates.

Preset.name: Tectonic Pulse
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: The heartbeat under a ticking-clock cue: a low animal-growl table that pumps on the eighths over a drone that never lets go. Velocity opens and drives it; the wheel is the intensity, brighter and dirtier; pressure tightens the resonance and brightens the drone.

Preset.name: Gravity Well
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A drone with no floor: a swarming voice table and a wide six-partial drone sinking into a thirty-second hole, with reversed grains an octave up glittering at the edge. Velocity opens it; the wheel brings up the grains; pressure raises the resonance and the drone's motion.

Preset.name: Desert Throat
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: Overtone throat singing: the vox table through a tight resonant ladder and an O vowel, the whistle sweeping slowly across the harmonics over a low drone. Velocity sharpens the formants; the wheel moves the vowel and the whistle; pressure tightens the resonance and drives the tube.

Preset.name: Prophecy Voice
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A lone wailing voice for the desert: the vox table sung legato with a slow glide, a vibrato that blooms after a second, breath, an octave of grains above and a hall with a long pre-delay. Velocity brightens the vowel; the wheel strains the voice brighter and lifts the grains; pressure strains the voice and adds breath.

Preset.name: War Taiko
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: Giant tuned drums: a drum skin struck hard over a sine thump that drops seven semitones in a sixth of a second, in a room big enough for an army. Velocity hits harder and brighter; the wheel pushes the drums back into the hall and lets them ring; pressure drives the tube and stiffens the skin.

Preset.name: Choir of Ash
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A dark choir the size of a canyon: the vox table singing an O that drifts toward U, an octave of grains above it and a drone below, in a fourteen-second hall. Velocity brightens the entry; the wheel is the crescendo, opening the vowel and filling in the grains; pressure lifts the formants and the resonance.

Preset.name: Monolith Chant
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: Monks an octave down in a stone hall: the vox table through a dark O vowel and a cello body, a slow wide vibrato, a stairwell's early reflections and a long tail. Velocity sharpens the formants; the wheel opens the vowel and drives the voices; pressure lifts the formants and brings the stone closer.

Preset.name: Dust Horizon
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: Sunrise over an endless desert: a drifting tambura table with slow pulse-width motion, a wide drone, sand-coloured air and grains an octave up, breathing in a twelve-second hall. Velocity opens it; the wheel is the swell, brighter and glittering; pressure deepens the motion and the air.

Preset.name: Cathedral Organ
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A pipe organ in a cathedral at the edge of space: an organ-pipe table, a sixteen-foot sub, a clean four-foot rank of grains and a ten-second nave, set back in the room. Velocity adds the upper rank; the wheel is the swell box; pressure changes the stop toward a reedier pulse.

Preset.name: Singularity
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: Falling into a black hole: a drifting spectral table and a six-partial drone smeared by slow reversed grains into a forty-five-second hole, everything wandering at the edge of hearing. Velocity opens it and scatters the grains; the wheel thickens the cloud and its resonance; pressure opens the ladder and drops the cloud an octave.

Preset.name: Frozen Planet
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: Ice to the horizon: a slow-pulsing ring-tone table sets a bell ringing an octave up in sympathy, grains glitter above and an exciter lights the top of a fourteen-second hall. Velocity strikes the bells harder; the wheel brings the bells and the glitter forward; pressure stretches the bells and opens the ice.

Preset.name: Monument
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: The anthem pad: drifting, pulse-warped power-fifth saws doubled by a cloud of unison grains and a touch of tape wow, a bright wide drone underneath and a big hall, as wide as the engine goes. Velocity opens it; the wheel is the intensity, brighter and denser; pressure adds resonance and deepens the pulse warp.

Preset.name: Endless Ascent
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A Shepard-tone riser that never arrives: the saw climbs an octave every two bars while a grain copy an octave below takes over, so the reset is never heard. Velocity opens and sharpens it; the wheel is the intensity, brighter and driven; pressure sharpens the resonance and pushes it back into the hall.

Preset.name: Razor Wire
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: Tension on a bowed wire: a stiff, bright string excited by grit and bow noise, its pitch wavering and its bow point scratching, through a starved tube into a steel tank. Velocity bows harder and brighter; the wheel stiffens the wire and drives it; pressure bends it sharp and moves the bow.

Preset.name: Battle Ostinato
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: Driving sixteenths for the chase: a solo-cello table gated on the sixteenths, sub and all, through a pentode and a multiband squeeze. Velocity digs in harder; the wheel is the intensity, brighter and denser; pressure bites the resonance and drives the tube.

Preset.name: Storm Riser
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: Six seconds of gathering storm: a saw, wind noise and a grain cloud swell together while the ladder, the noise and the pitch all climb, into a ten-second hall. Velocity starts it brighter and windier; the wheel rushes the rise and widens the room; pressure drives the tube and lifts the grains.

Preset.name: Black Sun
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: The villain's theme: a dark-matter growl table through a starved tube, tape saturation and bit loss, a resonant ladder that snarls at random, and a dark eleven-second hall. Velocity opens it and saturates harder; the wheel tears the ladder open and crushes it; pressure snarls the resonance and drops the bits.

Preset.name: Tine Memory
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: An electric piano from one operator: a sine body with a fourteen-times tine that flashes on the attack and dies in half a second, warmed by a triode and widened a little. Velocity strikes the tine harder; the wheel adds bark (operator feedback) and drive; pressure brings the tine back while you hold.

Preset.name: Feedback Hydra
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A snarling FM bass: a saw table phase-bent by a unison operator whose own feedback turns it into a rasp, a wobble in the index on the eighth notes, and a clean sine sub kept out of it. Velocity bites the attack; the wheel is the growl (the index); pressure is the snarl (feedback).

Preset.name: Ion Bell
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: The classic inharmonic FM bell: a sine bent at three and a half times its pitch, the index decaying with the ring so the clang settles into a pure tone, key-tracked so high notes stay glassy. Velocity strikes the clang harder; the wheel detunes the operator for slow beating; pressure holds the clang open.

Preset.name: Orbital Brass
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: Brass from a brass table with an operator in unison on top: the ladder swells open over a quarter second, the index rides the dynamics, and a horn vibrato arrives after a second of holding. Velocity sets how hard the attack speaks; the wheel is the dynamics (index and ladder); pressure adds rasp.

Preset.name: Tension Engine
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: An underscore engine for suspense: a groaning spectral table bent by an operator at one and a half times its pitch (a sub-octave fifth appears underneath), the index and the table position drifting on their own, into a long dark hall. Velocity sets the bite; the wheel is the intensity, raising the index; pressure feeds the operator back on itself.

Preset.name: Thunder Sheet
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A sheet of steel hung in a hall and hit with a padded beater: the plate model's twelve modes, including the near-twin pair that makes sheet metal shimmer, over a deep sine boom. The strike point drifts across the sheet so every hit rings differently. Velocity hits harder and brighter; the wheel moves the beater toward the edge; pressure drives the tube and lets it ring.

Preset.name: Temple Bowl
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A singing bowl: the ring modes of a thin bowl wall, each split into a slow-beating pair, struck softly and then rubbed by a hummed vocal table so it keeps singing while you hold. Velocity strikes harder; the wheel widens the beating and tilts it bright; pressure rubs harder.

Preset.name: Tam Bloom
Preset.author: iisben
Preset.description: A tam-tam in a cathedral: dense shell modes that, when hit hard, bloom upward a beat after the strike as the energy spreads into the high modes, then settle and fall slightly in pitch. Soft hits stay pure and dark. Velocity is the whole instrument (play hard for the bloom); the wheel lets it ring longer and darker; pressure drives the tube.
